convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for CandlesticksBW indicator and depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for position management, money management, and order execution logic

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before trading
TimeShiftSec - timeframe period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for position open timing

other_exits: Long position closed when CandlesticksBW buffer4[1] > 3 (bearish signal zone)
Short position closed when CandlesticksBW buffer4[1] < 2 (bullish signal zone)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM input (0.1) with MMMode=LOT means fixed lot size of 0.1; MMMode=LOT vs other MarginMode options determine whether MM is lot size or margin fraction - handled by TradeAlgorithms.mqh

custom_logic_notes: CandlesticksBW buffer 4 returns an integer-like value (1-5 range): values <2 = bullish zone, values >3 = bearish zone. Long entry triggers when buffer4[1]<2 AND buffer4[0]>1 (transition into bullish zone). Short entry triggers when buffer4[1]>3 AND buffer4[0]<4 (transition into bearish zone). SignalBar input controls which bar is used for signal evaluation (default=1, previous bar). When SignalBar=0, the EA evaluates every tick instead of only on new bars. UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime are set to last bar datetime + timeframe seconds, used by BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen from TradeAlgorithms.mqh for trade timing validation. Entry and exit are gated by boolean inputs: BuyPosOpen, SellPosOpen, BuyPosClose, SellPosClose.
python_conversion_notes: The CandlesticksBW custom indicator must be reimplemented or its logic reverse-engineered from its .mq5 source before Python conversion. Buffer 4 appears to return a categorical value (1=bullish, 2=neutral-bull, 3=neutral, 4=neutral-bear, 5=bearish) based on candlestick body/weight analysis with MA smoothing. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose functions - these must be reimplemented with equivalent position management, lot sizing, and order execution logic. The SL/TP values (1000/2000 pips) are very large suggesting this is designed for 5-digit brokers where 1000 points = 100 pips. Signal timing uses lastbar_date + timeframe_seconds which approximates next bar open time.
